summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test, a non-node input test, and a graph-unchanged test. Ran pytest on the new tests plus test/test_path.py with the generator venv: 41 passed. Not verified: mypy and ruff are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement was applied by reading the code only; the `/` operator on bare URIRefs in the test may need a type-ignore if mypy reports it. Nothing committed; no existing files modified.
